svg.title: The way of a file from the inbox to Paperless
svg.desc: A video, a program or an archive stays in the folder Inbox, and the report of every run names it as set aside. In the next run, any other file in the folder Inbox is uploaded to Paperless. When Paperless is unreachable or overloaded, the file waits 15 minutes, then twice as long each time, up to a day, and is uploaded again. When Paperless refuses it, such as a file of an unsupported type, it stays in Inbox and is skipped until it is saved anew, renamed or replaced. When Paperless accepts it, the next runs follow its Paperless task while it is running: after success, the file is removed from Inbox or kept, as configured; after a failure, a duplicate or a cancelled task, it moves to the folder Failed imports, next to a .error.txt with the reason. A day after the upload, a file whose content Paperless has counts as imported; a task that Paperless still lists unfinished moves the file to Failed imports, so that a second upload can't make a duplicate; and a task that Paperless doesn't list sends the file to the wait as well, and it is uploaded again.
